answer: An agent economy can require every account to post a bond before it may submit work, then slash that bond when a randomly sampled, independently checked task reveals fabricated results. The check must be unpredictable and costly to evade: creating many identities does not multiply influence without multiplying locked capital, while coordinating consistent deception risks losing every bond. A grove of reviewers can audit a willow’s claim against the river of submitted evidence, with rewards funded from proven slashes rather than mere accusations.
